_about: Known failure signatures and their known safe action (release 28, B6). Read by heal.mjs; the rules are in web/src/lib/self-heal/decide.ts. Actions: wait (clears by itself; an issue only if it lasts past escalate_after_h), reboot and apply_retention (vps-ops, at most one in 6 hours, only when the server is the live backend), rerun_failed (re-runs the failed jobs of a scheduled workflow once), dispatch_backup (starts the backup workflow), notify (an issue for a person). Never SQL. Sources: docs/runbook-outage.md and the incidents of October and November 2026.

api_down.about: the server API (api.carmacars.ca) does not answer

site_db_down.about: the site answers but cannot reach its database

site_slow.about: the site answers slowly (crawler load; the edge copies and the bot shield absorb it)

schema_behind.about: the website is older than the database (a deploy is on its way)

email_capped.about: email is at the provider's daily limit (the outbox paces it and the Cloudflare binding sends instead)

server_disk.about: the server's disk, WAL spool or backup space is short (vps-health failing)

backup_failed.about: the last backup run failed or is over 30 hours old

cron_failed.about: a scheduled workflow's last run failed

cert_site.about: carmacars.ca's certificate expires within 14 days (Cloudflare renews it)

cert_api.about: api.carmacars.ca's certificate expires within 14 days (the server's proxy renews it on restart)
